subject: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily@resellco.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace (CPPO) <aws-marketplace-cppo@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday — ResellCo is aligned to move forward on a CPPO for the initial pilot customers. To keep momentum, can you share a lightweight sprint proposal that spells out:

- roles and ownership for entitlement/provisioning (who will create the entitlements in AWS vs who verifies the SKU mapping)
- the cutover window and test plan (we prefer low-traffic weekend windows)
- what documentation / evidence AWS Marketplace will need from our side for enablement

I've looped in the AWS CPPO contact on this thread to flag any platform constraints up front. Our initial ask is to target a go-live with 2 customers by the end of June; that leaves ~6 weeks for entitlement mapping, legal sign-off, and PO routing.

Attachment: sample-customer-reqs.csv (CSV stub)

Can you send a short plan by early next week?

Thanks,
Emily Hart
Partnerships Lead | ResellCo
Em: emily@resellco.io | M: +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily@resellco.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace (CPPO) <aws-marketplace-cppo@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 13 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles

Emily — thanks, and appreciated the clarity on timeline.

High-level sprint proposal attached (sprint-plan-v1.xlsx). Key owners and asks below so we can lock names into the timeline:

- Entitlement mapping (SKU <-> ResellCo customer entity): ResellCo point (Emily) to provide entity list and preferred invoice payor. Redwood (Ben) will map SKUs and validate entitlement rules in our backend.
- CPPO setup and AWS evidence: Soojin will own the AWS evidence checklist and coordinate with the AWS CPPO rep for any missing items.
- Billing & invoice routing: Vanessa to own invoice routing and split configuration with ResellCo finance.
- Cutover window: proposed weekend of June 22-23 for a staged activation (test customers first).

Action items for ResellCo (please confirm):
1) Provide the list of customer legal entities + PAYOR email(s) (we need exact legal names for the PPO entity mapping).
2) Confirm preferred cutover weekend and blackout windows for your customers.
3) Share any corporate compliance docs AWS requires for marketplace listing (e.g., VAT/Tax entity certs).

Attachments: sprint-plan-v1.xlsx (Excel) — includes task-level owners, timelines, and rollback triggers.

If that looks good, we'll run a short 30-min alignment on Monday to assign legal/finance reviewers.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior GTM | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (617) 555-0140

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles

Team — forwarding Emily's request and the attached sprint plan. Short, specific asks below; please update the attached workbook with your expected lead times by EOD Wednesday.

Vanessa: we need the invoice routing template and the list of fields required for the PPO payor mapping. Flag any constraints for cross-border VAT handling — ResellCo has EU customers in scope for a later wave.

Ben: start the SKU mapping spreadsheet and confirm which SKUs can be enabled via CPPO vs requiring direct contract changes. Note any SKUs that will need entitlement overrides.

Soojin: own the AWS evidence pack (SOC2 date range, KMS/HSM attestations if required, and marketplace listing metadata). Coordinate with the AWS CPPO contact for exact docs — include timeline for when AWS will sign off.

We should treat this like a mini-sprint: 2-week preparation, 1-week dry-run, 1-week cutover. If we accelerate, we need legal looped earlier.

Quoted for context: "Can you send a short plan by early next week?"

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily@resellco.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace (CPPO) <aws-marketplace-cppo@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles

Hi Emily — attaching the updated sprint plan with owners and estimated lead times (sprint-plan-v1.xlsx) and the PPO entity mapping template (ppo-entity-map.pdf). Summary of next steps: 

1) ResellCo: Provide customer entity list + contact for invoice routing by May 20.
2) Redwood: Ben will complete SKU mapping by May 22 and flag any SKU gating.
3) AWS CPPO: Please confirm any additional evidence items by May 19 so Soojin can collect documents.
4) Legal/Finance: Vanessa will send invoice-split template and draft DocuSign for the PPO order form. DocuSign link (draft): https://www.docusign.com/contract/XYZ-12345

Planned cutover: staging test on June 15, production cutover weekend June 22-23. Rollback criteria documented in the attachment — we will not proceed to production activation for a customer if sync errors exceed 1% or entitlement mismatch rate >0.5% during validation.

Attachment: sprint-plan-v1.xlsx (Excel), ppo-entity-map.pdf (PDF)

Please confirm the entity list and I'll raise the DocuSign envelope for signature.

On Wed, May 16, 2028 at 09:10 AM Emily Hart <emily@resellco.io> wrote:
> Thanks — I'll confirm the list and get legal briefed.
>
Best,
Emily

From: Emily Hart <emily@resellco.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace (CPPO) <aws-marketplace-cppo@amazon.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace ops: entitlement sprint proposal and cutover roles

Aditya — confirmed. Attached is the customer entity CSV and a signed LOI (signed-loi.pdf). We can meet the May 20 list deadline.

Quick confirmations:
- Cutover weekend June 22-23 works for our pilot customers.
- ResellCo will be the payor for the first two pilot customers; Emily (legal@resellco.io) will be the payor contact for DocuSign.
- For AWS evidence: we already have SOC2 report and company KMS statements; I'll share via the secure link to Soojin.

Attachment: customer-entities.csv, signed-loi.pdf

Thanks,
Emily Hart
Partnerships Lead | ResellCo
